name: label
description: Text labels with the web typography and explicit native control activation.

props.name: controlRef
props.description: Input to focus when the label is pressed. Use onPress for selection controls.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description:
An accessibility hint helps users understand what will happen when they perform
an action on the accessibility element when that result is not obvious from the
accessibility label.


See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#accessibilityHint

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description:
Overrides the text that's read by the screen reader when the user interacts
with the element. By default, the label is constructed by traversing all
the children and accumulating all the `Text` nodes separated by space.

See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#accessibilitylabel

props.name: accessibilityState
props.description: Indicates to accessibility services that UI Component is in a specific State.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Specifies the disabled state of the text view for testing purposes.
Prevents activation and dims the label.

props.name: numberOfLines
props.description:
Truncate text with an ellipsis after this many lines. `0` means no
restriction.

docs:
## Label

`Label.Root` uses the web label's 14-pixel medium typography and tight line height. `disabled` dims it and prevents
activation. Native labels use `controlRef` to focus a TextInput, or `onPress` to activate another control; they do not
use DOM `htmlFor`. Supply a matching `accessibilityLabel` on the control so its purpose is announced independently.

The label forwards native Text props and merges `style` after its defaults. A prevented press does not focus the input.
